step1.description:
In this stream Million.js creator, Aiden Bai, joins us to talk about the latest performance improvements Virtual DOM-land, the Block VDOM. How is it so fast? Is it enough to change the way we look at Virtual DOMs? Maybe VDOMs aren't pure overhead afterall?
